task.title: Find and fix the bugs in an Express 'place order' API
task.brief: This Express + Mongoose route places an order for a small online shop. It has several bugs: some crash it, some lose money, and some are security holes. In about 25 minutes, list each problem you find, say why it matters, and write the corrected route (code does not need to run, but should be close). A good answer covers correctness, concurrency (two buyers at once), trust of client input, money handling with GST, error handling and status codes.
key_points: findById is not awaited, so product is a Query, not a document
No return after the 400 response, so the order continues and headers are sent twice
No check for a missing product (should return 404)
Price comes from the client; must use product.price from the database
userId comes from the body; must use req.user.id from the verified token
Read-check-save on stock is a race; use an atomic findOneAndUpdate with stock >= qty and $inc
Validate qty as a positive whole number
Money as floats; work in paise integers or round GST correctly
No try/catch or error middleware, and 201 is the right status for a created order

rubric.label: Bugs found and fixed
rubric.guide: 0 = no real bugs found, 3 = await/return/404 fixed but security or race missed, 5 = all major bugs found with a working fix

rubric.label: Security and trust
rubric.guide: 0 = trusts client price and userId, 3 = fixes one of them, 5 = uses DB price and req.user, validates input

rubric.label: Concurrency and edge cases
rubric.guide: 0 = ignores them, 3 = mentions the stock race without a sound fix, 5 = atomic conditional update plus qty and money handling

rubric.label: Explanation
rubric.guide: 0 = code only or unclear, 3 = some reasons given, 5 = each fix clearly explained in plain words
